newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakenes against dollar in week.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakenes against dollar in week.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr marginally weakened against the dollar this week, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said on Thursday.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6040 against the dollar compared to 6.6010 last week.
The bank said that following a currency auction on April 12, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the April 14 to 20 period would be 6.6040 birr on the dollar.
The bank posted the pound at a mean rate of 10.7314 against the pound from 10.7200 last week, while against the yen, the birr traded at 0.052454 from 0.052347 last week.
